annotations.title: Prayers left near a place (Prayer in Place)

description: List public prayers members have left at physical places (Prayer in Place: a street, hospital, school or town) within a radius of a point, nearest first: voice or written, the written words, a Scripture reference, who left it (first name or "someone"), how many prayed along, and when; plus worldwide totals. Use for "has anyone prayed near this hospital" or "prayers left in my town". Not for recorded prayers over the whole family (hear_the_kingdom_pray) or what people are carrying today (body_today). Needs lat+lng or city, else an error. Locations are the centre of an approximate grid cell (about 150 m), never the exact spot. None within the radius returns count 0 with the totals. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: A city, region or country, used when there are no coordinates: "Austin", "Kigali". Geocoded to its centre.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location. Must be paired with lng; coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around the point, 0.1 to 50 (default 5).

name: prayers_left_near

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

count.description: Prayers returned; 0 when none within the radius.

door.description: Link to Prayer in Place in the app.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

prayers.description: Nearest first: id, geohash cell and its approximate centre, place name or kind, prayer kind, whether it is a voice prayer, written words (null for voice), Scripture reference, first name or "someone", times heard, times prayed with, ISO time left, distance in km, and the cell's link.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

totals.description: Worldwide counts: prayers, places, places prayed at today.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Prayers left near a place (Prayer in Place)
